mapper.select: SELECT * FROM COLLECT_PCB b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = ( SELECT MAX(to_number(COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_PCB WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} )

SELECT ID, COLLECT_TIME, COLLECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, NAME, MODEL_NAME, TYPE, SERIAL_NUMBER_NAME, SOFTWARE_VERSION, HARDWATE_VERSION, DESC_STR, OS_VERSION, PCB_INDEX, CREATE_TIME, ENT_PHYSICAL_INDEX, ENT_PHYSICAL_CONTAINED_IN, ENT_PHYSICAL_PAR_PELPOS, ENT_PHYSICAL_IS_FRU, CASE WHEN SERIAL_NUMBER = '--' THEN '' ELSE SERIAL_NUMBER END AS SERIAL_NUMBER FROM COLLECT_PCB WHERE COLLECT_CODE = ( SELECT MAX(COLLECT_CODE) AS CODE FROM COLLECT_PCB WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} ) AND ASSET_ID = #{assetId} ORDER BY ENT_PHYSICAL_CONTAINED_IN, ENT_PHYSICAL_PAR_PELPOS
